parts.description: 130 dB 32-bit DAC + Class H headphone amp, QFN-40. I2C 0x30 (ADR to GND), MCLK 12.288 MHz from the VS1053 through the PLL
I2C level shifter 3.3 V <-> 1.8 V. EN/VREF2 through R702 200k from DAC_EN: the DAC leaves I2C1 when it is off
3.5 mm TRRS SMD jack with tip switch: 1 sleeve, 2 tip, 3 ring 1, 4 ring 2, 5 tip switch (closed to tip without a plug)
4-bit level shifter, I2S 3.3 V -> 1.8 V (A to B fixed). Outputs Hi-Z when DAC_1V8 is off
Bidirectional ESD, jack 2 (CS43131 outputs swing below ground)
4-ch ESD array, 0.5 pF, 10 nA: jack lines L, R, GBUF and HP1_DET. Place right at Jack1, short GND path
Generic connector, single row, 01x02, script generated (kicad-library-utils/schlib/autogen/connector/)
Battery reverse-polarity guard: drain on J3+, source on VBAT, gate to GND. On (~60 mOhm) both ways with a correct pack, off with a reversed one
5 V unidirectional TVS, 200 W, VBUS transient clamp after F2 (place next to USB1)
40-pin 0.5mm FPC connector for the TFT panels
2.4" TN TFT module, ILI9341 controller (40-pin FPC)
Haptic driver for LRAs and ERMs with effect library, 2-5.2V, VSSOP-10
Quick output discharge (DNP when JP101 is closed)
BT_EN pull-up: module powered by default
1-cell LiPo fuel gauge, ModelGauge, I2C 0x36, TDFN-8 2x2 (T822+3)
Single cell, Li-Ion/Li-Po charge management controller, 4.20V, Tri-State Status Output, in DFN-8 package
Load switch, 1-5.5 V, 2 A, adjustable slew rate, quick output discharge
2-A buck-boost converter, 1.3-5.5 V in, adjustable out (VFB 500 mV), 11 uA Iq, VSON-HR-10 (DLA)
300 mA ultra-low-noise LDO, 1.8 V fixed, active discharge, SOT-23-5. CS43131 VA/VCP/VD/VL (DAC_1V8), EN on DAC_EN
300 mA ultra-low-noise LDO, 3.3 V fixed, active discharge, SOT-23-5. VS1053 AVDD/IOVDD (+3.3VA via JP4)
Very low capacitance ESD protection diode, 2 data-line, SOT-23-6
Power inductor (earlier candidate for the buck-boost)
